videos.title: Gemini 4 Carbon Is Here (Fully Tested)
summary: Paul J Lipsky got early access from Google to Gemini 4 Carbon and spent two weeks testing it against the prior "Argon" version, walking through the games, business apps, writing, and video edits he produced with it.

The video is organized into timestamped chapters covering what Carbon is, games and visuals, generating images using code, building business apps, fixing app bugs, and how Carbon surfaces inside the Gemini app itself.

Lipsky closes with his take on Carbon's writing and video-editing strengths plus a rundown of access and pricing, giving viewers a verdict on where the new model impressed him and where it still falls short.

videos.title: Make Claude keep working until it's actually done
summary: Futurepedia's short video spotlights a Claude Code technique built around the /goal command, which the channel says keeps Claude working on a task continuously until it is actually finished rather than stopping early.

The core idea presented is that /goal only works reliably when the finish line is something Claude itself can verify, such as a passing test or a completed artifact, so it can self-check and keep iterating instead of declaring premature success.

Positioned as a quick practical tip rather than a deep tutorial, the video continues Futurepedia's pattern of surfacing small Claude Code workflow tricks for developers who want longer-running, more autonomous agent sessions.
